mcq_questions.description: ﻿প্রদত্ত: sec⁡2(tan⁡−12)+csc⁡2(cot⁡−13)ধরি, θ=tan⁡−12⇒tan⁡θ=2sec⁡2θ=1+tan⁡2θ=1+22=5ধরি, ϕ=cot⁡−13⇒cot⁡ϕ=3csc⁡2ϕ=1+cot⁡2ϕ=1+32=10∴sec⁡2(tan⁡−12)+csc⁡2(cot⁡−13)=5+10=15\text{প্রদত্ত: } \sec^2(\tan^{-1} 2) + \csc^2(\cot^{-1} 3) \\[10pt] \text{ধরি, } \theta = \tan^{-1} 2 \Rightarrow \tan \theta = 2 \\[6pt] \sec^2 \theta = 1 + \tan^2 \theta = 1 + 2^2 = 5 \\[10pt] \text{ধরি, } \phi = \cot^{-1} 3 \Rightarrow \cot \phi = 3 \\[6pt] \csc^2 \phi = 1 + \cot^2 \phi = 1 + 3^2 = 10 \\[10pt] \therefore \sec^2(\tan^{-1} 2) + \csc^2(\cot^{-1} 3) = 5 + 10 = \boxed{15}প্রদত্ত: sec2(tan−12)+csc2(cot−13)ধরি, θ=tan−12⇒tanθ=2sec2θ=1+tan2θ=1+22=5ধরি, ϕ=cot−13⇒cotϕ=3csc2ϕ=1+cot2ϕ=1+32=10∴sec2(tan−12)+csc2(cot−13)=5+10=15​﻿
